feature.title: Download a course as an EPUB book
feature.problem: A course can only be read inside Coursewright. The owner wants to take one course to an e-reader (Apple Books, Kobo, Kindle via Send to Kindle) and read it offline, as a book: the lessons in order, the drawings, the questions and the projects.
nonGoals: Moving Flowmovie diagrams: an EPUB cannot play them; the book prints each diagram's step-by-step text instead.
The learner's own notes, progress and tutor chats: the book holds only the course.
PDF or other formats, and exporting several courses at once.
The phone and iPad reader app: export is on the web course page only.

surfaces.name: Course page: Download as EPUB

moments.peak: choosing 'Download as EPUB' and the browser saving 'build-domain-expert-agents-on-pi.epub' a moment later
moments.end: the book opens in Apple Books with the title page, a module-by-module contents and every drawing in place

surfaces.purpose: Save the whole course as one EPUB file.

fields.label: Course options ⋯
fields.value: Extend this course · Download as EPUB · Delete course

fields.label: Modules
fields.value: the course's modules and lessons, as today

states.loading: While the book is built the menu item shows 'Preparing book…' with a loader and cannot be chosen twice.
states.empty: A course that is still being written has no lessons yet: the item is disabled with the hint 'Available when the course is ready'.
states.error: A red notification: 'Could not build the book. Try again.' The course page is unchanged.
states.success: The browser saves <course-title>.epub; a green notification says 'Book downloaded'.

components.control: Menu item 'Download as EPUB' with a BookDown icon in the existing Course options menu
components.why: a rare whole-course action like Extend and Delete; the menu keeps the header to one primary button
components.rejected: a header button (competes with Continue) and a dialog with format options (there is one format)

components.control: Mantine notifications for success and failure
components.why: the download happens in the background and needs only a short confirmation
components.rejected: an Alert on the page (it would stay after the download is done)

entities.name: EPUB book (built on request, not stored)
fields: title page: course title, summary, module and lesson counts
contents (nav.xhtml and toc.ncx): modules, then their lessons
one XHTML file per lesson: markdown to XHTML, code blocks kept, Inkling drawings rendered to SVG (final frame), Flowmovie and Mermaid diagrams as their titles and step text
'Check yourself' questions at the end of each lesson, answers and explanations after them
projects appendix: brief, starter files, milestones and rubric per module project

endpoints.purpose: builds and returns the EPUB (application/epub+zip, Content-Disposition attachment); 404 for an unknown course, 409 while the course is not ready

integration.to: useDownloadCourseEpub → coursewrightService.downloadEpub (axios, responseType blob) → saves the file
integration.note: MSW handler returns a small fixture EPUB
stdlib zipfile; markdown-it-py for markdown; inkling render via the vendored CLI under Node, falling back to the drawing's title when Node is missing
same builder for a course folder, so authored courses can be checked as books before import

verification: pytest: the book is a valid EPUB 3 zip (mimetype first and stored, container.xml, opf manifest lists every file, nav lists every lesson), every lesson present, Inkling SVG embedded, questions and answers present
epubcheck on the domain-experts-on-pi book if available, else open it in Apple Books
vitest: menu item calls the service, shows loading, success and error notifications; disabled while the course is not ready
Download from the running app against the Mac mini and open the file
